title: 654. Smallest Range Covering Elements from K Lists

examples.explanation: 20 comes from list 2, 22/24 from others; span 4 is minimal.
Picking 1 from each list gives a zero-width range.

hints: Seed a min-heap with the first entry of every list and record the maximum among them.
Repeatedly pop the minimum: the current [min, max] is a candidate covering all lists.
Then advance inside the popped list (updating the max) until some list runs dry; keep the shortest candidate, breaking ties by smaller start.
Adaptation: the nested input maps to int_array_2d and the two-element answer maps to int_array in this judge.
